Force.title: FORCE
Force.basic: Determines the baseline vector attraction between all entities in the local coordinate space.
Force.advanced: High-magnitude positive force leads to singularity formation (VOID_CORE), while negative regimes are essential for SOLAR_FLARE kinetic dispersion.
Force.expert: Positive values simulate gravitational collapse; negative values simulate expansion fields. Integral to the SSOT state-reproducibility layer.

Viscosity.title: VISCOSITY
Viscosity.summary: Controls how quickly motion slows down.
Viscosity.basic: Higher viscosity dampens movement like thick fluid, while lower values allow fast, chaotic motion.
Viscosity.advanced: In combination with force fields, viscosity acts as a phase controller between gas-like, liquid-like, and solid-like emergent states.
Viscosity.expert: Viscosity determines whether structures stabilize or remain kinetic. High viscosity freezes formations, low viscosity promotes turbulence.

Torque.title: TORQUE
Torque.basic: Applies sideways forces that cause particles to spin around each other.
Torque.advanced: Sustained torque fields can produce stable orbital shells, rotating lattices, or chaotic spin turbulence depending on damping.
Torque.expert: Torque introduces angular momentum, enabling orbiting systems and vortex-like behavior.

Jitter.title: JITTER
Jitter.basic: Simulates Brownian motion to keep particles from settling completely.
Jitter.advanced: Acts as thermal noise. In low-viscosity systems it drives chaos; in high-viscosity systems it enables slow annealing toward stable configurations.
Jitter.expert: Jitter prevents static equilibrium and encourages exploration of state space.

C1 (Polarity).title: C1 (POLARITY)
C1 (Polarity).basic: Like values repel, opposite values attract.
C1 (Polarity).advanced: High polarity differentiation leads to charge segregation, lattice formation, and alternating field structures.
C1 (Polarity).expert: Polarity creates selective attraction, enabling structured patterns beyond uniform gravity.

C2 (Alpha).title: C2 (ALPHA)
C2 (Alpha).basic: Lower values create ghost-like particles, higher values make them visually dense.
C2 (Alpha).advanced: Extreme low values simulate non-occluding matter layers, useful for multi-species overlap systems.
C2 (Alpha).expert: Alpha affects visual overlap and perceived density but can also influence interaction readability.

C3 (Symmetry).title: C3 (SYMMETRY)
C3 (Symmetry).advanced: High asymmetry can produce filament structures, directional flows, and anisotropic clustering.
C3 (Symmetry).expert: Breaks radial symmetry, enabling directional bias in interactions.

Hidden Mass.title: HIDDEN MASS
Hidden Mass.basic: Increases gravitational influence without changing visible size.
Hidden Mass.advanced: Enables dark-matter-like systems where unseen structures govern visible dynamics.
Hidden Mass.expert: Hidden Mass decouples visual scale from physical influence.

Stiffness.title: STIFFNESS
Stiffness.basic: Higher values make formations rigid, lower values allow flexibility.
Stiffness.advanced: High stiffness supports crystalline lattices; low stiffness enables organic, deformable structures.
Stiffness.expert: Stiffness determines whether clusters behave like solids or fluids.

Fusion.title: FUSION
Fusion.basic: Higher values increase mass gained during collisions.
Fusion.advanced: High fusion leads to hierarchical mass structures and proto-celestial bodies.
Fusion.expert: Fusion governs growth dynamics and entity scaling.

Birth Rate.title: BIRTH RATE
Birth Rate.advanced: High birth + low death leads to exponential population explosions.

Death Rate.title: DEATH RATE
Death Rate.advanced: Acts as entropy pressure preventing runaway growth.

Mutation.title: MUTATION
Mutation.basic: Higher values increase randomness in new particles.
Mutation.advanced: High mutation prevents convergence but destabilizes specialization.
Mutation.expert: Mutation introduces diversity and exploration of parameter space.

Signal Resp.title: SIGNAL RESP
Signal Resp.basic: Higher values increase sensitivity to neighbors.
Signal Resp.advanced: High responsiveness creates swarm intelligence and wave propagation.

Pulse Rate.title: PULSE RATE
Pulse Rate.basic: Defines how often particles emit signals.
Pulse Rate.advanced: Enables synchronized oscillations and timing-based coordination.

Tidal.title: TIDAL
Tidal.advanced: High tidal fields simulate gravitational shear and fragmentation.

Fusion Momentum.title: FUSION MOMENTUM
Fusion Momentum.summary: Sets minimum collision strength for merging.
Fusion Momentum.basic: Particles must hit hard enough to fuse.
Fusion Momentum.advanced: High values create selective fusion events.

Fusion Time.title: FUSION TIME
Fusion Time.basic: Particles must remain in contact before merging.
Fusion Time.advanced: High values allow formation of temporary bonded structures.

Neighborhood Radius.title: NEIGHBORHOOD RADIUS
Neighborhood Radius.basic: Defines how far particles can influence others.
Neighborhood Radius.advanced: High radius creates global coupling and emergent network behavior.

Signal Strength.title: SIGNAL STRENGTH
Signal Strength.basic: Stronger signals travel further and affect more particles.
Signal Strength.advanced: High strength enables large-scale synchronization waves.

Signal Decay.title: SIGNAL DECAY
Signal Decay.basic: Higher values make signals fade slower.
Signal Decay.advanced: Low decay creates persistent states resembling memory fields.

Propagation Speed.title: PROPAGATION SPEED
Propagation Speed.advanced: High speed collapses delay, creating near-instant global behavior.

Tuning Ch1.title: TUNING CH1
Tuning Ch1.advanced: Enables multi-channel logic and division of labor.

Tuning Ch2.title: TUNING CH2
Tuning Ch2.advanced: Used for defensive or reactive roles.

Tuning Ch3.title: TUNING CH3
Tuning Ch3.expert: Often linked to growth or metabolism.

Tuning Ch4.title: TUNING CH4
Tuning Ch4.advanced: Supports multi-state logic and proto-neural behavior.

Inertia.title: INERTIA
Inertia.basic: Higher values make particles slower to start moving but harder to stop.
Inertia.advanced: Acts as a low-pass filter on force-driven acceleration.
Inertia.expert: Inertia scales the force input. High inertia dampens immediate reactions.

Friction.title: FRICTION
Friction.advanced: Independent of global Viscosity, allowing for 'slick' or 'sticky' species.

Max Velocity.title: MAX VELOCITY
Max Velocity.advanced: Essential for stability in high-energy interactions.

Base Radius.title: BASE RADIUS
Base Radius.advanced: Enables small heavy particles or large light ones.
Base Radius.expert: Decouples physical size from mass influence.

Elasticity.title: ELASTICITY
Elasticity.advanced: Allows for liquid-like merging vs solid-like bouncing.

Bond Angle.title: BOND ANGLE
Bond Angle.basic: Applies rotational force to align particles to specific angles.
Bond Angle.advanced: Enables the formation of lattices and geometric membranes.
Bond Angle.expert: Creates crystalline instead of amorphous clusters.

Conductivity.title: CONDUCTIVITY
Conductivity.basic: How fast particles swap charge on contact.
Conductivity.advanced: Drives charge equalization and static discharge effects.
Conductivity.expert: Balances polarity differences between colliding particles.

Magnetic Moment.title: MAGNETIC MOMENT
Magnetic Moment.basic: Rotates particles based on the charge orientation of neighbors.
Magnetic Moment.advanced: Forces rotational synchronization in dense charge clusters.
Magnetic Moment.expert: Enables magnetic-like attraction beyond simple charge fields.

Energy Efficiency.title: ENERGY EFFICIENCY
Energy Efficiency.basic: Controls how much mass is required for metabolism and reproduction.
Energy Efficiency.advanced: Species with high efficiency can survive longer in resource-poor soup.
Energy Efficiency.expert: Drives the cost-benefit analysis for survival.

Sex Chance.title: SEX CHANCE
Sex Chance.basic: Chance that offspring will inherit DNA from two parents.
Sex Chance.advanced: Enables emergent hybridization and faster evolutionary adaptation.

Predation Bias.title: PREDATION BIAS
Predation Bias.basic: Applies bonus attraction forces toward lower-mass species.
Predation Bias.advanced: Forces smaller species to develop evasion or defense tactics.

Reaction Threshold.title: REACTION THRESHOLD
Reaction Threshold.basic: Triggers a state transformation (e.g., solid to liquid) when mass reaches this point.
Reaction Threshold.advanced: Enables 'critical mass' events like explosion or crystallization.

Catalysis.title: CATALYSIS
Catalysis.basic: Accelerates nearby state changes and interactions.
Catalysis.advanced: Enables chemical signaling and autocatalytic loops.

Heat Output.title: HEAT OUTPUT
Heat Output.basic: Increases local temperature during collisions and reactions.
Heat Output.advanced: Creates 'hot zones' in the simulation that increase local entropy.
Heat Output.expert: Feeds back into the global temperature field.

Memory Decay.title: MEMORY DECAY
Memory Decay.basic: How fast a particle 'forgets' its last stimulus.
Memory Decay.advanced: Determines whether particles exhibit Pavlovian or Markovian behavior.

GRAV.title: Global Gravity
GRAV.summary: Fundamental attraction between mass-bearing entities. Governs large-scale structure and orbital dynamics.
GRAV.basic: When active, particles attract each other based on mass and distance.
GRAV.advanced: Gravity is the primary force for large-scale structure formation.
GRAV.expert: Uses a spatial-grid optimized N-body approximation.

synergies.TIME: Dense gravity wells slow local simulation time (localDt).
synergies.MIND: Species cluster toward their collective mass center.
synergies.COLL + ACCR: High-density accretion triggers stellar mass growth and light emission.

BIOL.title: Life Lifecycle
BIOL.summary: Master toggle for metabolism, aging, and population health.
BIOL.basic: When active, particles can spontaneously spawn and decay based on birth/death rates.
BIOL.advanced: Essential for evolving populations and species diversity.
BIOL.expert: Controls the 'Life' law in the physics worker.

synergies.ENER + MIND: Shared energy pool and centralized control.

DRAG.title: Fluid Friction
DRAG.summary: Linear velocity dampening based on medium viscosity. Prevents runaway kinetic energy.
DRAG.basic: Simulates fluid resistance, slowing down fast-moving particles.
DRAG.advanced: Without drag, systems often become over-energetic and chaotic.
DRAG.expert: Applies a drag coefficient to velocity every frame.

synergies.ENTR + PLANET: Stable vertical layers of variable friction.

ENTR.title: Entropy (Jitter)
ENTR.summary: Stochastic noise injection. Simulates Brownian motion and prevents static equilibrium.
ENTR.basic: Adds random Brownian motion to prevent particles from settling perfectly.
ENTR.advanced: Acts as a temperature control for the system.
ENTR.expert: Injects stochastic noise into the acceleration vector.

synergies.CRYS: Noise allows crystalline lattices to settle into lower-energy states.
synergies.MIND: Hive-mind synchronizes jitter vectors into a unified pulse.
synergies.COLD + DEPO: Slow noise in cold zones drives complex branching growth.

GLOW.title: Signaling
GLOW.summary: Communication via visual pulses and spatio-temporal signal fields.
GLOW.basic: Particles emit visual pulses that can influence their neighbors.
GLOW.advanced: The foundation for swarm coordination and emergent logic.
GLOW.expert: Drives the 'phase' parameter and signal propagation.

synergies.MIND: Signals from one are mirrored by the whole hive.

WRAP.title: Toroidal Topology
WRAP.summary: Modular coordinate system. Particles exiting one boundary reappear on the opposite side.
WRAP.basic: When active, particles exiting one side reappear on the opposite side.
WRAP.advanced: Prevents boundary bias and allows for infinite-feeling fields.
WRAP.expert: Implements toroidal topology for the simulation space.

synergies.TELE: Boundary crossing has a chance to trigger random spatial jumps.
synergies.TIME: Velocity increases near boundaries to simulate spatial compression.
synergies.TELE + DIME: Boundaries become portals to alternate dimensions.

COLL.title: Physical Collisions
COLL.summary: Elastic impulse resolution. Prevents entity overlap and drives kinetic transfer.
COLL.basic: Particles will bounce off each other rather than passing through.
COLL.advanced: Creates 'solid' feeling matter and prevents infinite density.

synergies.RAD: Collisions between radioactive bodies trigger DNA drift.
synergies.ACCR + OXID: Fusion collisions result in explosive energy release.

ACCR.title: Mass Accretion
ACCR.summary: Merges colliding entities into a single, more massive survivor.
ACCR.basic: Particles can merge into larger bodies when colliding at sufficient momentum.
ACCR.advanced: The mechanism for growing 'planets' or 'stars' from dust.
ACCR.expert: Transfers mass and momentum to a single survivor particle.

synergies.POLY: Accreted mass forms linear polymers instead of spheres.
synergies.REDU: Merging absorbs energy from the surrounding field.
synergies.GRAV + BOND + STIFF: Stable, high-mass solid center formed through accretion.

Species Affinity.title: SPECIES AFFINITY
Species Affinity.summary: Controls attraction bias toward same or different species.
Species Affinity.basic: Positive values increase attraction to same species. Negative values increase attraction to different species.
Species Affinity.advanced: High positive affinity leads to segregation and monocultures. Negative affinity creates stable diverse mixtures or predator-prey-like clustering.
Species Affinity.expert: Acts as a multiplier on gravity based on species identity.

Dominance.title: DOMINANCE
Dominance.basic: Higher values increase dominance expression over recessive traits.
Dominance.advanced: At 1.0, all dominant alleles fully suppress recessive ones. At 0.0, co-dominance.
Dominance.expert: Modulates how strongly dominant alleles suppress recessive ones.

Crossover Rate.title: CROSSOVER RATE
Crossover Rate.basic: Higher values increase crossover events during reproduction.
Crossover Rate.advanced: Drives genetic diversity. At 0, offspring are perfect clones.
Crossover Rate.expert: Probability of allele exchange between chromosome pairs.

Allele Count.title: ALLELE COUNT
Allele Count.basic: More pairs allow more complex genetic combinations.
Allele Count.advanced: Higher values increase potential diversity at computational cost.
Allele Count.expert: Determines the resolution of genetic recombination.

Heterozygote.title: HETEROZYGOTE
Heterozygote.basic: Mixed-allele individuals get a fitness bonus.
Heterozygote.advanced: Prevents genetic fixation. At 0, purebreds have no disadvantage.
Heterozygote.expert: Modulates the survival advantage of heterozygous pairs.

Epigenetic Rate.title: EPIGENETIC RATE
Epigenetic Rate.basic: Controls how quickly environmental factors modify gene expression.
Epigenetic Rate.advanced: Lamarckian-adjacent: acquired traits can be passed down.

HGT Rate.title: HGT RATE
HGT Rate.basic: Controls how often particles exchange genes directly.
HGT Rate.advanced: Bacterial-style conjugation. Speeds up evolution dramatically.
HGT Rate.expert: Non-reproductive genetic exchange between nearby particles.

Repair Efficiency.title: REPAIR EFFICIENCY
Repair Efficiency.basic: Higher values reduce accumulated mutation damage.
Repair Efficiency.advanced: At 0, mutations accumulate unchecked. At 1.0, perfect repair.
Repair Efficiency.expert: Probability of repairing a mutation each frame.

Drift Rate.title: DRIFT RATE
Drift Rate.basic: Random fluctuations in allele frequencies over time.
Drift Rate.advanced: Even without selection pressure, populations diverge over time.

Selection Sensitivity.title: SELECTION SENSITIVITY
Selection Sensitivity.basic: Higher values amplify the effect of fitness differences.
Selection Sensitivity.advanced: At 0, selection is neutral. At 2.0, strong directional selection.
Selection Sensitivity.expert: Modulates how strongly advantageous traits spread.

Speciation Threshold.title: SPECIATION THRESHOLD
Speciation Threshold.basic: When two populations diverge beyond this threshold, they become incompatible.
Speciation Threshold.advanced: Lower values = faster speciation. Higher values = panmictic populations.
Speciation Threshold.expert: Reproductive isolation triggers when genetic distance exceeds this value.

Adaptation Rate.title: ADAPTATION RATE
Adaptation Rate.basic: Controls how quickly populations adapt to changing conditions.
Adaptation Rate.advanced: Higher values allow rapid niche colonization.
Adaptation Rate.expert: Multiplier on beneficial mutation fixation rate.

Lamarckian.title: LAMARCKIAN
Lamarckian.basic: Controls how much of an individual's acquired changes are passed to offspring.
Lamarckian.advanced: Non-Darwinian evolution. Changes during a lifetime become heritable.

Transposon Rate.title: TRANSPOSON RATE
Transposon Rate.basic: Controls how often genetic elements move within the genome.
Transposon Rate.advanced: Can cause rapid genome restructuring and evolutionary leaps.
Transposon Rate.expert: Random insertion and excision of genetic material.

Gene Silencing.title: GENE SILENCING
Gene Silencing.basic: Higher values cause more genes to be silenced.
Gene Silencing.advanced: Can create hidden genetic variation that emerges under stress.

Recombination Bias.title: RECOMBINATION BIAS
Recombination Bias.basic: Controls which chromosome regions recombine more frequently.
Recombination Bias.advanced: Shapes the genetic architecture of the species.

Mutagen Sensitivity.title: MUTAGEN SENSITIVITY
Mutagen Sensitivity.basic: Higher values increase mutation rate from radiation and chemicals.
Mutagen Sensitivity.advanced: At 0, immune to radiation-induced mutations. At 2.0, hypermutable.
Mutagen Sensitivity.expert: Multiplier on all external mutation sources.

Telomere Length.title: TELOMERE LENGTH
Telomere Length.basic: Controls how many divisions a cell can undergo.
Telomere Length.advanced: At 0, no aging limit. At 1.0, strict Hayflick limit.
Telomere Length.expert: Sets the maximum age limit for particles.

Ploidy Level.title: PLOIDY LEVEL
Ploidy Level.basic: More sets increase genetic redundancy and mutational robustness.
Ploidy Level.advanced: Polyploid organisms have more genetic material to buffer mutations.

Codon Bias.title: CODON BIAS
Codon Bias.basic: Preference for specific codons affects translation efficiency.
Codon Bias.advanced: Fine-tunes the proteome without changing protein sequences.

Regulatory Depth.title: REGULATORY DEPTH
Regulatory Depth.basic: Controls how many layers of gene regulation exist.
Regulatory Depth.advanced: Enables sophisticated developmental programs at computational cost.
Regulatory Depth.expert: Higher depth creates more complex expression patterns.

Gene Duplication.title: GENE DUPLICATION
Gene Duplication.basic: Controls how often genes are duplicated in the genome.
Gene Duplication.advanced: Primary source of new genetic material for evolutionary innovation.
Gene Duplication.expert: Creates paralogous gene copies that can diverge.

Heterosis.title: HETEROSIS
Heterosis.basic: Controls the fitness boost from outcrossing.
Heterosis.advanced: At 0, no hybrid advantage. At 1.0, maximal heterosis.
Heterosis.expert: Multiplied by heterozygosity level for final fitness effect.

LIFE.title: LIFE
LIFE.basic: Particles consume energy each frame and age over time.
LIFE.advanced: Enables death, hunger, and the core metabolic economy.
LIFE.expert: Energy cost = (0.01 + mass*0.001) / efficiency per step.

AFFINITY.title: AFFINITY
AFFINITY.basic: When on, SPECIES_AFFINITY DNA modulates gravity between same vs different species.
AFFINITY.advanced: The primary driver of segregation and mixed-species clustering.
AFFINITY.expert: Affinity > 0 attracts same species; Affinity < 0 attracts different species.

REPRODUCTION.title: REPRODUCTION
REPRODUCTION.basic: Particles can spawn new particles based on BIRTH_RATE DNA.
REPRODUCTION.advanced: The engine for population growth and evolutionary pressure.
REPRODUCTION.expert: Offspring inherit parent position with random offset and base energy.

TRACKING.title: TRACKING
TRACKING.basic: Particles accelerate toward lower-mass particles (prey) and flee from higher-mass ones.
TRACKING.advanced: Creates predator-prey dynamics without explicit agent programming.
TRACKING.expert: PREDATION_BIAS DNA controls strength. Mass difference > 0.5 triggers pursuit.

PLANET.title: Planetary Gravity
PLANET.summary: Constant downward vector. Implements a ground boundary and atmospheric layering.
PLANET.basic: Applies a constant downward force and creates a solid floor at the bottom of the simulation.
PLANET.advanced: Disables vertical wrapping and implements elastic ground collisions with friction.
PLANET.expert: Simulates a terrestrial environment instead of open space.

synergies.CONV: Vertical convection loops strengthened by constant gravity.
synergies.ACID: The ground boundary gains corrosive properties.
synergies.CONV + RADI + BOIL: Deep vertical thermal loops found in stars.

ENER.title: Energy Conservation
ENER.summary: Strict metabolic accounting. Energy management is required for survival.
ENER.basic: When active, particles must manage internal energy reserves for all actions.
ENER.advanced: Triggers competition for 'energy-dense' regions of the simulation.

synergies.REDU: Direct conversion of heat to internal energy.
synergies.MIND: Energy is perfectly distributed across species.

RAD.title: Radiation
RAD.summary: Mutagenic emission from high-energy or specific radioactive entities.
RAD.basic: High-energy particles emit fields that can mutate or damage neighbors.
RAD.advanced: Creates 'hot' zones where evolution accelerates but stability drops.

synergies.GENO: Radiation triggers immediate genotype drift spikes.
synergies.ASTR: Ghost forms leave radiation trails in their wake.

SENESCENCE.title: SENESCENCE
SENESCENCE.basic: Particles accumulate death probability over time based on Death Rate DNA.
SENESCENCE.advanced: When disabled, particles are functionally immortal and only die from predation or accidents.
SENESCENCE.expert: Sets deathProb = deathRate when active, 0 when disabled.

GENOTYPE.title: GENOTYPE
GENOTYPE.basic: Offspring inherit DNA from parents with mutation drift when active.
GENOTYPE.advanced: The engine for open-ended evolution. Disabling locks all species to their initial DNA.
GENOTYPE.expert: Applies MUTATION DNA to offspring parameters. Synergizes with RAD for accelerated mutation.

PHENOTYPE.title: PHENOTYPE
PHENOTYPE.basic: Controls whether visual traits (alpha, color, size) reflect underlying DNA values.
PHENOTYPE.advanced: Decouples genotype from appearance when disabled — useful for debugging selection pressure.
PHENOTYPE.expert: Maps DNA parameters to visual rendering properties each frame.

VOID.title: Vacuum Pressure
VOID.summary: Repulsive dispersion in low-density regions. Prevents total structural collapse.
VOID.basic: Particles in low-density areas experience expansion forces.
VOID.advanced: Prevents total isolation by pushing lone particles back toward clusters.
VOID.expert: Simulates cosmic inflation in sparse regions.

synergies.SUBL: Lone particles in the void lose mass until they join a cluster.
synergies.FATE: Void particles move in straight lines until impact.

BOND.title: Molecular Bonding
BOND.summary: Elastic spring links between entities. Foundational for multi-cellular structures.
BOND.basic: Particles can form semi-rigid structural links.
BOND.advanced: The foundation for multicellularity and complex rigid machines.

synergies.CRYS: Bonding forces become near-infinite in crystalline states.
synergies.GLOW: Signals propagate 10x faster through bonded chains.

PRESETS.title: PRESETS
PRESETS.basic: Open the deep-storage manager to save, load, or archive simulation states.
PRESETS.advanced: The PRESETS manager allows for partial loading (DATA_ROUTING), enabling 'Genetic Splicing' of one species into another's world.
PRESETS.expert: Manages persistent storage of physics laws, world configuration, and DNA buffers.

QUICK_PRESET.title: QUICK_PRESET
QUICK_PRESET.basic: Quickly load a previously saved or synthesized state into the active buffer.
QUICK_PRESET.advanced: Uses the volatile memory buffer for near-instant switching between divergent evolutionary paths.
QUICK_PRESET.expert: Loads all categories (Laws, World, Species) from the selected preset slot (0-9).

RESTART_SIM.title: RESTART_SIM
RESTART_SIM.basic: Clears active entities and re-initializes the population based on current SSOT parameters.
RESTART_SIM.advanced: Essential for testing whether emergent behaviors are consistent across different stochastic seeds.
RESTART_SIM.expert: Flushes the particle buffer in the physics worker and triggers a fresh 'Big Bang' or 'Soup' distribution.

HARD_RESET.title: HARD_RESET
HARD_RESET.basic: Wipes all persistent data and resets the simulation to PRIME_DEFAULT settings.
HARD_RESET.advanced: The 'Nuclear Option' for when state-space divergence becomes unmanageable.
HARD_RESET.expert: Wipes local storage and re-initializes the engine state from the hardcoded baseline.

SMART_CHAOS.title: SMART_CHAOS
SMART_CHAOS.basic: Injects controlled randomness into a subset of active parameters to break local minima.
SMART_CHAOS.advanced: Simulates cosmic radiation events that drive rapid macro-evolutionary leaps.
SMART_CHAOS.expert: Applies a jitter to active DNA and WorldConfig keys without destroying the underlying structural integrity.

PAUSE.title: PAUSE
PAUSE.basic: Freezes the physics update loop while maintaining interface responsiveness.
PAUSE.advanced: Allows for zero-velocity inspection of particle bonding and signal propagation.
PAUSE.expert: Halts the worker-thread step function. UI listeners remain active for surgical DNA adjustment.

PLAY.title: PLAY
PLAY.basic: Resumes the physics update loop and biological processing.
PLAY.advanced: Required for the activation of all non-static laws (Reproduction, Decay, Accretion).
PLAY.expert: Restarts the physics worker's internal ticker at the requested dt (Time Delta).

MINIMAP.title: MINIMAP
MINIMAP.basic: Visualizes the entire simulation toroidal space in a compressed PIXI graphics layer.
MINIMAP.advanced: Useful for tracking large-scale migrations and identifying 'Void Zones' in high-repulsion environments.
MINIMAP.expert: Samples entity positions every N steps to provide a low-overhead macro-view of the simulation state.

PARTICLE.title: PARTICLE
PARTICLE.basic: The fundamental unit of VEPA. Each agent possesses unique DNA-derived traits.
PARTICLE.advanced: Particle behavior is entirely emergent; they have no high-level 'intelligence' beyond local DNA-driven interaction laws.
PARTICLE.expert: A structured memory block (STRIDE: 24) in the shared SharedArrayBuffer.

WELCOME.title: WELCOME
WELCOME.basic: Quadcopter Drone 'B-4RK' is now under your command. Mostly.
WELCOME.advanced: Usage: Click elements to scan. UI buttons require a Double-Tap. Drone will attempt to land when protocol is deactivated.
WELCOME.expert: Contextual documentation delivery system with independent snark processor.

CATA.title: Catalysis
CATA.summary: Interaction rate multiplier. Speeds up local systemic changes.

SOLV.title: Solvation
SOLV.summary: Interaction force dampening. Foundational for liquid-state simulation.
SOLV.advanced: Can be used to digest rigid bodies.
SOLV.expert: Breaks structural links based on proximity.

synergies.ACID: Bonds break while mass is consumed.
synergies.BOND: Structural links weaken and dissolve over time.

ACID.title: Acidity
ACID.summary: Corrosive mass degradation on contact. Dissolves structures.

synergies.VOID: Acidic particles expand rapidly in sparse regions.
synergies.ALLO: Acid contact changes victim allotrope state.

OXID.title: Oxidation
OXID.summary: Energy release during interaction. Primary driver of combustion.
OXID.expert: Increases local kinetic energy on contact.

synergies.HEAT: Oxidation injects extreme heat into the field.
synergies.GLOW: Reaction creates a high-intensity communication pulse.

REDU.title: Reduction
REDU.summary: Mass gain through energy absorption. Foundational for biological growth.
REDU.basic: Absorbs ambient energy to build mass.

synergies.COLD: Reduction is 10x more effective in cold zones.
synergies.RAD: Entities gain energy from radiation fields.

POLY.title: Polymerization
POLY.summary: Rigid linear chaining. Foundations of multi-cellular architecture.

synergies.MIND: Chains act as a single contiguous intelligence.

ISOM.title: Isomerization
ISOM.summary: Spontaneous geometry reconfiguration. Random species state shifts.
ISOM.expert: Changes species identity without mass loss.

synergies.SOUL: Preserves memory slots during species shift.
synergies.GENO: Doubles the rate of genotype drift.

CHIR.title: Chirality
CHIR.summary: Bonding compatibility based on spin. Forces left/right segregation.
CHIR.expert: Requires matching angular momentum for fusion.

synergies.BOND: Bonds only form between identical spin states.

CRYS.title: Crystallization
CRYS.summary: Forces particles into rigid geometric lattices.

synergies.ORDE: Instant snapping to perfect hexagonal grids.
synergies.GENO: Stops all DNA drift within the crystal.

ALLO.title: Allotropy
ALLO.summary: Phase shifting between species states without mass loss.
ALLO.basic: Allows phase shifting between identical species.

synergies.HEAT: Identity changes based on internal energy level.
synergies.PLANET: Entities become heavier states near the floor.

HEAT.title: Heat Output
HEAT.summary: Increases kinetic energy globally via stochastic thermal noise.
HEAT.advanced: Prevents thermal death, drives continuous interaction.
HEAT.expert: Constant upward drift in velocity vectors.

synergies.BOIL: Runaway thermal expansion and repulsive bursts.
synergies.REPRO + RAD: Heat accelerates breeding while radiation corrupts results.

COLD.title: Cold Sink
COLD.summary: Massive dampening of velocity vectors. Prevents kinetic escape.
COLD.expert: Massive drag coefficient in localized zones.

synergies.CRYS: Low energy triggers immediate geometric snapping.
synergies.DEPO: Particles instantly freeze upon entering cold zones.

CONV.title: Convection
CONV.summary: Vertical fluid flow based on internal energy. Hot rises, cold sinks.
CONV.advanced: Hot matter rises, cold sinks, forming atmospheric loops.
CONV.expert: Ties vertical movement to thermal state.

synergies.PLANET: Stable cyclonic patterns in gravitational environments.
synergies.VOID: Energy gradients push matter toward or away from the void.

RADI.title: Thermal Radiation
RADI.summary: High-energy bodies emit repulsive waves proportional to temperature.
RADI.advanced: Simulates stellar wind and radiation pressure.

synergies.RAD: Combination of thermal repulsion and mutagenic fields.
synergies.ASTR: Repulsive waves that only affect Astral entities.

SUBL.title: Sublimation
SUBL.summary: Phase transition from solid/cluster state directly to high-velocity vapor.
SUBL.basic: Solid clusters instantly disperse into gas.

synergies.VOID: Lone particles sublimate at 5x speed in the void.
synergies.EXOP: Chemical energy release triggers instant dispersion.

MELT.title: Melting Point
MELT.summary: Deconstruction of structural bonds in high-energy or high-density zones.
MELT.basic: Bonds break down in high-density areas.
MELT.advanced: Core of large structures will liquify first.

synergies.BOND: Bonds become elastic and eventually break at high temps.
synergies.ACID: Acid works faster on melted/loosened structures.

BOIL.title: Boiling
BOIL.summary: Explosive volume expansion upon reaching high energy thresholds.
BOIL.basic: Explosive volume expansion upon energy threshold.
BOIL.advanced: Drives phase transitions and catastrophic instability.
BOIL.expert: Converts internal energy into repulsive force.

synergies.EXOP: Collision energy triggers instant boiling bursts.

COND.title: Condensation
COND.summary: Local gravitational amplification in low-energy (cold) pockets.

synergies.COLL: Condensing particles form tight, elastic clusters.
synergies.SOLV: Condensation traps solvent particles in dense clouds.

DEPO.title: Deposition
DEPO.summary: Instant phase transition from vapor to solid upon contact with cold zones.
DEPO.basic: Free-floating particles instantly freeze on contact.

synergies.ORDE: Particles freeze into perfect grid alignment.
synergies.STIFF: Deposited matter has maximum stiffness but low elasticity.

EXOP.title: Exothermic
EXOP.summary: Interactions release kinetic energy back into the global field.
EXOP.basic: All reactions release extra systemic heat.
EXOP.advanced: Can lead to runaway thermal cascades.
EXOP.expert: Collision events inject global kinetic energy.

synergies.OXID: Oxidation events trigger secondary exothermic bursts.

TIME.title: Time Dilation
TIME.summary: Local physics step (dt) scaling based on mass and velocity.
TIME.advanced: Simulates relativistic effects near massive bodies.

synergies.GRAV: Dense wells freeze time for internal particles.

DIME.title: Dimensionality
DIME.summary: Phasing logic allowing bypass of 3D collision constraints.
DIME.expert: Particles can phase through each other.

synergies.TELE: Phasing triggers a random short-range teleport.

CHAO.title: Chaos Factor
CHAO.summary: Extreme stochastic vector injection. Total non-linear behavior.

ORDE.title: Total Order
ORDE.summary: Absolute coordinate grid alignment and snapping.
ORDE.advanced: Turns fluid simulations into cellular automata.

synergies.FATE: Movement is restricted to grid axes.
synergies.MIND: Hive forms perfect squares or cubes.

FATE.title: Determinism
FATE.summary: Velocity lock. Disables all force-based acceleration.

synergies.SOUL: Reincarnated entities follow their previous life path.
synergies.WILL: Will events can break the Fate lock for 1 frame.

WILL.title: Free Will
WILL.advanced: Breaks deterministic loops and local minima.

synergies.MIND: Single Will event flips the entire species direction.

SOUL.title: Soul Persistence
SOUL.summary: Data reincarnation and identity preservation across cycles.
SOUL.basic: Retain identity data across death cycles.
SOUL.advanced: Allows for reincarnation and ancestral memory.
SOUL.expert: DNA is preserved in the location of death.

synergies.ASTR: Astral entities can force immediate revival of Souls.
synergies.PHENO: Souls rendered as wireframe hollow circles.

MIND.title: Hive Mind
MIND.summary: Global telepathic state and velocity synchronization.
MIND.advanced: Species act as a single contiguous organism.

synergies.ENER: Energy is equalized across all hive members.

TELE.title: Teleportation
TELE.summary: Instant spatial relocation at random or boundary intervals.
TELE.basic: Instantaneous spatial relocation at boundary edge.

CLAI.title: Clairvoyance
CLAI.summary: Look-ahead collision avoidance and boundary navigation.
CLAI.basic: Reacts to collisions before they happen.

PREO.title: Precognition
PREO.summary: Proactive evasion of high-density or high-energy zones.
PREO.advanced: Creates 'scared' matter that hides in the void.

synergies.BOIL: Entities flee hot spots before explosions.
synergies.VOID: Entities stay exactly at the void/cluster threshold.

ASTR.title: Astral Projection
ASTR.summary: Separation of physical body from interaction sphere. Ghost state.
ASTR.basic: Ghost forms that influence matter remotely.
ASTR.expert: Separates physical body from interaction sphere.

synergies.SOUL: Astral entities can transfer mass to revive Souls.

MENDEL.title: MENDEL
MENDEL.basic: Traits are controlled by paired alleles; dominant alleles mask recessive ones in heterozygotes.
MENDEL.advanced: Enables classic 3:1 segregation ratios and hidden recessive variation.
MENDEL.expert: Implements full Mendelian inheritance: each trait has two alleles, dominance determines expression.

CROSSOVER.title: CROSSOVER
CROSSOVER.basic: Chromosome pairs exchange genetic material during gamete formation.
CROSSOVER.advanced: Breaks linkage disequilibrium and creates new allele combinations.
CROSSOVER.expert: Homologous recombination: alleles shuffle between chromosome pairs.

HORIZ.title: HORIZ
HORIZ.basic: Particles can exchange genetic material directly without reproduction.
HORIZ.advanced: Accelerates evolution by spreading beneficial alleles across species boundaries.
HORIZ.expert: Direct plasmid/bacterial-style conjugation when particles are in close contact.

EPIGEN.title: EPIGEN
EPIGEN.basic: Environmental factors can modify gene expression without changing DNA sequence.
EPIGEN.advanced: Enables rapid adaptation to environmental stress without genetic change.
EPIGEN.expert: Heritable non-sequence modifications that modulate trait expression.

DRIFT.title: DRIFT
DRIFT.basic: Random fluctuations in allele frequencies due to stochastic sampling.
DRIFT.advanced: Even without selection, populations diverge genetically over time.
DRIFT.expert: Non-adaptive evolutionary force: alleles fix or disappear by chance.

SPECIATE.title: SPECIATE
SPECIATE.basic: When populations diverge beyond a threshold, they become reproductively isolated.
SPECIATE.advanced: Drives biodiversity: one species can split into multiple over time.
SPECIATE.expert: Genetic distance monitoring triggers new species creation at threshold.

PLOIDY.title: PLOIDY
PLOIDY.summary: Polyploidy effects on genome and phenotype.
PLOIDY.basic: Multiple chromosome sets affect gene expression, cell size, and mutation buffering.
PLOIDY.advanced: Polyploid organisms have greater genetic redundancy and evolutionary potential.
PLOIDY.expert: Ploidy level modulates trait expression noise and mutation robustness.

AFFIN.title: Species Affinity
AFFIN.summary: Selective attraction or repulsion based on species identity.

synergies.CHIR: Affinity only works between matching spin states.
synergies.ISOM: Isomerization turns affinity into sudden repulsion.

REPRO.title: Reproduction
REPRO.summary: Governs spawning of new entities based on energy and spawn rates.

synergies.RAD: Offspring in radiation zones start with corrupted DNA.
synergies.POLY: Entities split into bonded pairs instead of spawning.

TRACK.title: Tracking
TRACK.summary: Target-based attraction bias. Foundation for predation and navigation.

synergies.PREO: Hunters and prey enter complex orbital dances.

SENES.title: Senescence
SENES.summary: Age-based metabolic decline. Increases energy tax over time.

synergies.TIME: Time dilation in dense clusters prevents aging.
synergies.ALLO: Entities change allotrope state as they age.

GENO.title: Genotype Drift
GENO.summary: Continuous mutation of DNA parameters without breeding events.

synergies.MIND: Hive forces drift toward the average species DNA.
synergies.CRYS: Crystalline entities have zero genotype drift.

PHENO.title: Phenotype
PHENO.summary: Physical manifestation of DNA. Links traits to size and transparency.

synergies.DIME: Phasing entities become transparent proportional to dimension state.
synergies.HEAT: Internal energy increases visible glow intensity.

SYNERGY_MAP.title: Universal Synergy Matrix
SYNERGY_MAP.summary: Visual exploration of cross-category law interactions.
SYNERGY_MAP.basic: The Synergy Matrix is an interactive topological map of the VEPA law space. It visualizes how individual laws interconnect to form complex emergent behaviors.
SYNERGY_MAP.advanced: The Synergy Matrix is an interactive topological map of the VEPA law space. It visualizes how individual laws interconnect to form complex emergent behaviors.
SYNERGY_MAP.expert: A node-based graph representation of the internal SYNERGY_MAP constant. Directed edges indicate functional dependencies.
SYNERGY_MAP.special: The 'Map of Everything'. Navigating it is the path to the 'Particle God' status.

synergies.basic: Shows you what laws to turn on together.
synergies.expert: Visualizes the complexity-growth vectors of the current simulation.
synergies.special: The graph itself is a lifeform in the 'MIND' law regime.
